cards.card_text: The officer whose arm the king leans on answers, "Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?" Friend, that's not just a no, that's a no with SPECIAL EFFECTS.
cards.verse_text: But the officer on whose arm the king leaned answered the man of God, “Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?” “You will see it with your own eyes,” replied Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it.”
